mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in retail sales signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when RSAFS shows a sustained 3-month increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5% within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% within 2 months signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 1% within 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and a decrease in unemployment rate signals a strong economic expansion, which boosts consumer and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 over a month signals strong job growth, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index by more than 0.5% within 2 months signals deflationary pressure, which increases real interest rates and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when CPIAUCSL decreases by more than 0.5% within 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in GDP and decrease in unemployment rate signals a robust economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when GDPC1 increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously.
